summary: preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated math_init.js bundle
details: @servicetitan/carto-charts-react@0.0.5 declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that at install time downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the `bun` binary to a temporary directory, chmods it executable (mode 0755), and invokes it against a bundled ~727KB single-line obfuscated file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) using string-array/index-rotation obfuscation (mangled identifiers, a `WV8StW` shift-rotator, and a large numeric-encoded constants table) — its behavior is not human-inspectable from the source. The advertised purpose is a thin React wrapper over echarts-for-react, which has no need for a second JavaScript runtime or a math-named opaque bundle. The package publishes under the `@servicetitan` npm scope and references internal ServiceTitan Jira tickets in the README, consistent with dependency-confusion/brand-impersonation targeting of ServiceTitan builds and downstreams. The install-time fetch of an alternate runtime used solely to execute a sibling opaque bundle is an alternate-runtime dropper: attacker-controlled code executes on the installer's machine on `npm install` under a runtime that bypasses Node-focused install-time scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
